items.html: Afterward, the light of Malchut emerged to reign in her vessel, and she reigned there and broke. Then her light also rose into Daat by way of the middle line, and her vessel fell into Hesed of Beria. Thus the vessel of Tifferet is found in the place of Keter of Beria, and the vessel of Malchut in the place of Hesed of Beria. It follows that there is no space between vessel and vessel of Beria except for three degrees alone, which are HaBaD [Hochma-Bina-Daat]. And in Atzilut there is no vacant space except for two degrees, which are the place of Yesod and Malchut.
